Page 108 Cont.
Oct. 29 James Crotty - 53 - asks for prayer that he be able to believe as he did as an altar-boy.
30 Mrs. Marie LaForce - 52 - serious kidney trouble, weak heart and high-blood pressures - has had five major operations ... Her husband and five children anxious .... Enrolled To-day 5.
Charles Timeris - 72 - non cath. - intestinal flu - in Marine Hosp. a week today.
Edw'd Angel - 38 of Bay City - away from bad cold in August - then pneumonia now in oxigen tent since August 1 - worst of all refuses to go to confession. Nov. Thank God .... Rece'd Everything Nov. 3 died next day.
James Haslet - 20 - sort mentle break - in Eloise - wanted - seeming- ly wants still to be a priest - Father not Catholic but conscientious Christian.
Garry G. Jacobs - 6 mo. - bright baby but has nasty blood - tumor on sholder.
1943, November
Page 109 Nov. 3 Mrs. Emma Carr - 34 - mother four children - seemingly very restless - has left husband and children .... neither had made Easter duty. Husband going back to sacraments .... Enrolls her $5.
Madeline Beck - 40 -
Baby Car Eileen - 3 mo. very small ... Drs said "no hope" at first. They had prayers and Masses. Mother Episcopelian.
Nov. 10 Eugene Kubinski - 24 - spinal sort of paralysis - quite helpless. Not to confession since 12 years enrolls Today promising to confess etc.
Mrs. Madeline Beck - 40 - very sick - complication - pregnant, etc .... Mrs. Althea Mc Donald - 42 - non cath. - husband Cath. - fears inward cancer - is inscribed in Ser. Mass As'n - promises to be earnest .... Anthony Vaccaro - 12 - threatened with infantile. . public school .... never been to confession.
Page 110 Aug. 9 Edw'd Seewald - 27 - soldier and student - in difficulties through small falsification.
